summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a 6-K reporting definitive purchase agreements, dated September 21, 2026, to acquire five precious-metals streams and royalties from Orion Mine Finance for US$290 million total consideration — US$200 million cash and US$90 million in Elemental shares, equal to roughly 5.6% of issued and outstanding shares. Assets include Ruby Hill silver, Kouroussa gold, La Negra, Richmond Hill and Snowy River royalties. Concurrently, CEO David M. Cole resigned; founder Frederick Bell was appointed CEO and director. National Bank of Canada committed to upsize the revolver from US$150 million to US$250 million, retaining a US$50 million accordion. Closing is expected Q4 2026, with Snowy River up to Q1 2027, subject to TSX listing and New Zealand approvals. Watch financing execution, regulatory timing for Snowy River and equity overhang from the share issuance.
